sourceRules.afterText: You may discharge coils: - 1 Coil: Gain 1 action. - 2 Coils: Also, draw 1 card.
Choose one: - Charge both coils - Discharge both coils to have Tesla recover 2 health

sourceRules.duringText: You may discharge coils: - 1 Coil: This card's value is 5. - 2 Coils: Instead, this card's value is 7.

sourceRules.afterText: Draw 1 card. You may discharge coils: - 1 Coil: Instead, draw 2 cards. - 2 Coils: Instead, draw 3 cards and Tesla recovers 1 health.
Charge one coil. If you won the combat, charge both.
You may discharge coils: - 1 Coil: Deal 1 damage to each opposing fighter in your zone. - 2 Coils: Instead, deal 2 damage.

sourceRules.immediateText: You may discharge coils: - 1 Coil: Cancel all effects on your opponent's card. - 2 Coils: Also, ignore that card's value.

sourceRules.basicText: Move all opposing fighters up to 2 spaces. Gain 1 action.

sourceRules.afterText: Move the opposing fighter up to 2 spaces. You may discharge coils: - 1 Coil: Also, move Tesla up to 2 spaces. - 2 Coils: Also, your opponent discards 1 random card.

sourceRules.duringText: Reveal the top card of your opponent's deck. You may discharge coils: - 1 Coil: Discard that card. - 2 Coils: Also, add its boost value to this card's value.
